ranked.headline: Learned representations and label-efficient models for single-cell imaging and omics
ranked.summary: Imaging and single-cell omics increasingly rely on learned models, and label-efficient, self-supervised tools are emerging to reduce annotation burden.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models predict immunogenicity of neoantigens and tumor epitopes
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair omics-derived tumor antigen discovery with learned immunogenicity models, targeting neoepitope selection for vaccines and immunotherapy.

ranked.headline: Large-scale genome and metagenome mining links sequence content to microbial traits
ranked.summary: Expanding genome and metagenome collections now allow specific trait classes to be assigned from broad microbial sampling.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence models tackle resistance, interactions and mRNA design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply genomic, mRNA and protein language models to resistance, interaction and zoonotic surveillance tasks.

ranked.headline: Foundation and graph models for spatial and single-cell transcriptomic representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair spatial and single-cell foundation models with scrutiny of benchmark sampling biases.

ranked.headline: Attention over biomedical graphs predicts binding, perturbation, and interaction outcomes
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous biomedical graphs are now paired with attention, ensemble, and multi-view architectures across prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Simulation and modeling probe biomolecular binding and protein conformational states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published MAX study apply metadynamics, free energy, and adaptive MD to drug, condensate, and protein-state questions.

ranked.headline: Statistical and deep learning methods for microbiome and multi-omics analysis
ranked.summary: Expanded curated microbiome resources, including 22,710 metagenomes, make systematic benchmarking of analysis methods feasible.

ranked.headline: Pretrained structure and sequence models repurposed for constrained molecular design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers couple learned representations with geometric, chemical, and synthesizability constraints for small-molecule and peptide design.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings drive stability and phase separation prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply protein language model embeddings and generative models to stability, phase separation, and cryo-EM density tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test whether protein AI models predict antibody developability and co-folding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark co-folding and developability predictions while generative models design low-immunogenicity antibodies and peptides.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and burden models score variant effects beyond single loci
ranked.summary: Variant interpretation is moving beyond single-variant scores toward interaction-level and multi-locus effect modeling.

ranked.headline: Summary-statistics and haplotype tools estimate heritability, haplogroups and ancestry
ranked.summary: Scalable, open implementations now extend heritability, Y-chromosome, and ancestry inference to larger reference panels and ancient DNA data.

ranked.headline: Graph and deep learning models predict cancer subtypes and drug-drug interactions
ranked.summary: Multi-omics, attention, graph, and adversarial architectures are being applied to cancer and drug-interaction prediction from molecular data.

ranked.headline: Restraints and force-field tests refine peptide and RNA conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: NMR chemical shifts and NOEs are now being integrated into coarse-grained force fields, while force fields are benchmarked against experimental distributions.

ranked.headline: Omics tools convert platform outputs into validated, analysis-ready forms
ranked.summary: Large-scale metabolomics and RNA-seq analyses increasingly demand automated, validated, and interoperable processing that bridges existing tools.

ranked.headline: Intrinsic noise limits timing precision and robustness in gene regulatory circuits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study model intrinsic noise and regulatory delays in gene circuits, deriving analytical limits and control motifs.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics traces gene family gains, losses, and innovation across eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study extend lineage-resolved annotation of miRNAs, plant genomes, and protein domains across broad phylogenies.

ranked.headline: Learned and flexible scoring extend sequence alignment beyond fixed rules
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published study target alignment scoring limits in tandem repeats, multiple alignment, and orphan gene detection.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-aware single-cell tools for CRISPR editing and lentiviral integration mapping
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend genomic tools for CRISPR editing outcomes, viral integration sites, and guide design across single-cell and population data.

ranked.headline: LLMs and deep recommenders predict drug combinations and druggable disease-target links
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply LLMs, temporally validated recommenders, and benchmark audits to drug combination and target-disease prediction.

ranked.headline: Software redesigns speed molecular surface, electrostatics, and property prediction
ranked.summary: Efficiency gains in core structure-based and molecular modeling tools reduce compute and memory costs for large biomolecular and chemical workflows.

ranked.headline: LLMs Orchestrate Retrieval and Curation Across Biomedical Resources
ranked.summary: Preprints now report LLMs acting as agents over curated biomedical resources, alongside contamination-free capability benchmarks for protein science.

ranked.headline: Analysis tools pair computational methods with curated biological data and access
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package GPU cloud access, community-curated 3D datasets, agent benchmarks and parameter-free genomic search into usable tools.

ranked.headline: Epigenetic state linked to locus-specific chromatin mechanics and nucleosome energetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints assign viscoelastic and thermodynamic properties to individual loci according to their epigenetic marks.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer microbial biosynthesis traits from genomes and literature
ranked.summary: Foundation and language models now operate at genome-collection and literature scale, linking microbial genomes to phenotypes and biosynthetic output.

ranked.headline: Open tools released for non-canonical residues, RNA ensembles and lipid nanobubble MD
ranked.summary: Recent releases package structural and simulation analysis for non-canonical residues, RNA ensembles and lipid nanobubble simulations as accessible software.

ranked.headline: Interactive computational tools span membrane nanostructure, neuron biophysics and EM
ranked.summary: Methods for nanoscale, single-neuron, and EM analysis are now packaged as interactive or web-accessible tools for direct use.

ranked.headline: Transposon enhancers and acrocentric chromosome evolution reshape genome regulation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie transposon co-option, acrocentric chromosome evolution, and gene family expansion to regulatory and evolutionary change.

ranked.headline: Models of ciliary mixing, corneal repair, EGFR signaling and epithelial migration
ranked.summary: Recent items couple explicit models of ciliary flow, EGFR signaling, and epithelial dynamics to tissue-scale behavior.

ranked.headline: Simulations map residue-level determinants of amyloid aggregation and its inhibition
ranked.summary: Residue-resolved MD distinguishes specific contacts from net charge in controlling aggregation-prone interfaces across Tau, α-synuclein, Aβ, and myocilin.

ranked.headline: Path-integral and graph models infer treatment and fitness dynamics from limited data
ranked.summary: Stochastic, graph, and fitness-landscape models now infer dynamics directly from calibrated or longitudinal measurements.

ranked.headline: Generative AI designs antimicrobial peptides with targeted and programmable properties
ranked.summary: Late-December 2025 items report generative and ML pipelines for antibacterial peptides and small molecules, with one lead compound validated.

ranked.headline: Bacterial metabolic, antifungal, and protein interaction prediction models
ranked.summary: Late-2025 work extends bacterial prediction to genome-scale metabolic models, metagenomic antifungal screening, and protein interaction networks.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for stable protein design and genetically stable gene constructs
ranked.summary: Recent publications apply joint sequence-structure optimization, language-model directed evolution, and recombination-aware codon design to engineering.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved genomes tie haplotype diversity to resistance in wild plant relatives
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale haplotype-resolved assemblies now resolve allelic variation underlying pest and pathogen resistance in crop wild relatives.

ranked.headline: Physics-based and deep learning models extend RNA structure and nanopore read analysis
ranked.summary: Chemical probing, linear-time structural-context inference and raw nanopore current now feed RNA structure models directly.

ranked.headline: Linking multimodal molecular structure to interpretable drivers and causal instruments
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair multimodal omics topic models, causal instrumental factors, and Perturb-seq design with explicit molecular structure.
